name: Conditionals
description: Zero, first, second and third conditionals, mixed conditionals, wish and if only, and alternatives to if such as unless and provided that.

passages.title: What Happens to Ice
passages.content:
If you (1) ______ ice, it melts. If you put water in the freezer, it (2) ______ into ice after a few hours.

Yesterday my little brother asked what (3) ______ if we left a glass of water outside in winter. I told him that if it (4) ______ very cold tonight, the water will freeze. If he (5) ______ me in the morning, we can check it together.

passages.title: What Would You Do with a Million?
passages.content:
Our English teacher asked us what we (1) ______ if we won a million hryvnias. Sofia said that if she (2) ______ that much money, she would travel around the world.

Artem said he (3) ______ it all on himself, because he would give most of it to an animal hospital. 'If I (4) ______ you,' the teacher told him, 'I would keep a little for university.' As for me, I would buy a house by the sea, if my parents (5) ______ me.

passages.title: The Missed Bus
passages.content:
This morning I missed the bus by one minute. If I (1) ______ up earlier, I would have caught it. And if I had caught it, I (2) ______ late for my maths test.

The teacher said that if I (3) ______ an alarm on my phone, this wouldn't have happened. Next time, if I (4) ______ up late, I will take a taxi. And if I (5) ______ a bike, I would ride to school every day.

passages.title: An Accidental Discovery
passages.content:
In 1928 Alexander Fleming left a dish of bacteria uncovered before going on holiday. If he (1) ______ it, mould would never have grown on it. When he returned, he noticed that the bacteria near the mould had died.

If he (2) ______ so observant, the world might still be waiting for antibiotics. Today doctors warn that unless we use antibiotics carefully, they (3) ______ working. 'If people (4) ______ taking them the moment they feel better,' one expert says, 'resistant bacteria would be far less common.' Had Fleming not been curious, millions of lives (5) ______ lost since then.

questions.title: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: Нульовий тип описує незмінну закономірність: в обох частинах Present Simple.

questions.title: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the picnic.
questions.explanation: Перший тип: після «if» — Present Simple, у головній частині — «will».

questions.title: If I had more time, I ___ a musical instrument.
questions.explanation: Другий тип описує нереальну теперішню ситуацію: Past Simple + «would».

questions.title: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam.
questions.explanation: Третій тип описує нереальне минуле: Past Perfect + «would have» + третя форма.

questions.title: Which conditional describes something always true?
questions.explanation: Нульовий тип описує те, що справджується завжди.

questions.title: Which conditional describes an imaginary present situation?
questions.explanation: Другий тип описує уявну ситуацію в теперішньому.

questions.title: We will be late ___ we leave now.
questions.explanation: «Unless» означає «якщо не» й уже містить заперечення.

questions.title: If I ___ you, I would apologise straight away.
questions.explanation: У конструкції «If I were you» вживають «were» для всіх осіб.

questions.title: I wish I ___ how to swim.
questions.explanation: Після «I wish» про теперішнє вживають Past Simple.

questions.title: Take a jumper ___ it gets cold in the evening.
questions.explanation: «In case» означає «на випадок, якщо» — це запобіжна дія.

questions.title: If you press this button, the machine ___.
questions.explanation: Незмінний наслідок дії описують нульовим типом.

questions.title: What tense follows 'if' in the first conditional?
questions.explanation: У першому типі після «if» стоїть Present Simple, а не «will».

questions.title: If we ___ earlier, we would have caught the train.
questions.explanation: Третій тип: після «if» — Past Perfect.

questions.title: I would go to the party ___ I were not so tired.
questions.explanation: Другий тип уводиться сполучником «if».

questions.title: Match each conditional type with a sentence that illustrates it.
pairs: If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
If it snows, we will stay at home.
If I won the lottery, I would travel.
If I had known, I would have told you.
questions.explanation: Тип умовного речення визначають за часами в обох частинах.

questions.title: Match each conditional type with the situation it describes.
pairs: something that is always the case
questions.explanation: Кожен тип описує свій ступінь реальності ситуації.

questions.title: Match each linking word with its meaning in a conditional sentence.
questions.explanation: Кожен сполучник додає умові свій відтінок.

questions.title: Match each sentence beginning with the clause that completes it.
pairs: we will have time to talk.
questions.explanation: Час у головній частині залежить від типу умовного речення.

questions.title: If the train ___ on time, we would already be at the conference.
questions.explanation: Причина в минулому, наслідок у теперішньому — змішаний тип із Past Perfect.

questions.title: If I had accepted that job, I ___ in Warsaw now.
questions.explanation: Змішаний тип: минула умова, теперішній наслідок — «would be living».

questions.title: If she were more organised, she ___ the deadline last week.
questions.explanation: Змішаний тип: теперішня риса, минулий наслідок — «would not have missed».

questions.title: I wish you ___ interrupting me all the time.
questions.explanation: «I wish» + «would» виражає роздратування чужою поведінкою.

questions.title: If only I ___ that email before the meeting.
questions.explanation: «If only» + Past Perfect виражає жаль про минуле.

questions.title: ___ you need any help, do not hesitate to contact us.
questions.explanation: «Should you need» — формальна інверсійна умова замість «if you need».

questions.title: Which sentence about conditionals contains a mistake?
options: If I will see him, I will tell him.
If I see him, I will tell him.
If I saw him, I would tell him.
If I had seen him, I would have told him.
questions.explanation: Після «if» майбутній час не вживають — потрібен Present Simple.

questions.title: You may borrow the car ___ you return it by six.
questions.explanation: «Provided that» означає «за умови, що».

questions.title: He behaves ___ he owned the place.
questions.explanation: «As if» уводить нереальне порівняння, тому далі йде форма минулого часу.

questions.title: I would rather you ___ anything to her about it.
questions.explanation: Після «would rather» у другій особі вживають форму минулого часу.

questions.title: It is high time we ___ this discussion.
questions.explanation: Після «It is high time» уживають Past Simple.

questions.title: But for your advice, I ___ the wrong course.
questions.explanation: «But for» означає «якби не» й вимагає «would have» + третьої форми.

questions.title: Suppose you ___ the chance to start again, what would you change?
questions.explanation: Після «Suppose» в нереальній ситуації вживають Past Simple.

questions.title: Match each mixed conditional with the time relationship it shows.
pairs: If I had saved more, I would be richer now.
a past cause with a present result
If I were braver, I would have spoken up.
a present quality with a past result
If she had left earlier, she would be here.
an unrealised past action affecting now
If he were not so shy, he would have applied.
a lasting trait explaining a past failure
questions.explanation: Змішані типи поєднують різні часові площини причини й наслідку.

questions.title: Match each wish structure with its meaning.
pairs: I wish I had a car.
I wish I had bought a car.
I wish you would drive more slowly.
questions.explanation: Конструкція після «wish» показує, до чого саме стосується жаль.

questions.title: Match each alternative to 'if' with the sentence it fits.
pairs: We will go unless it rains.
You can stay as long as you are quiet.
Hurry up, otherwise we will be late.
But for the delay, we would have arrived.
questions.explanation: Кожен замінник «if» має власне значення й будову.

questions.title: Match each inverted conditional with its full form.
pairs: Were it not for the rain
If it were not for the rain
questions.explanation: У формальному стилі «if» опускають, а замість нього роблять інверсію.

questions.title: Match each faulty conditional with the reason it is wrong.
pairs: If I would have time, I would come.
would is not used in the if clause
If it will rain, we stay in.
the first conditional needs a present tense
If she was me, she would refuse.
were is preferred in the unreal second conditional
If they had left, they will arrive on time.
the third conditional needs a perfect result
questions.explanation: Кожна помилка має свою причину: «would» після «if», майбутній час, «was» замість «were».

questions.title: Were the funding ___ withdrawn, the whole project would collapse.
questions.explanation: «Were … to be» — формальна інверсійна умова з відтінком малоймовірності.

questions.title: Had it not been for the intervention of the mediator, the talks ___.
questions.explanation: «Had it not been for» — інверсійна форма третього типу.

questions.title: Which sentence is the most formal way of stating a condition?
options: In the event that the deadline is missed, penalties will apply.
If the deadline is missed, you get a penalty.
Miss the deadline and you pay a penalty.
When missing the deadline, penalties apply to you.
questions.explanation: «In the event that» — найформальніший спосіб увести умову.

questions.title: Which sentence expresses a hypothetical outcome the speaker considers unlikely?
options: If the minister were to resign, an election would follow.
If the minister resigns, an election follows.
If the minister has resigned, an election followed.
If the minister had resigned, an election follows now.
questions.explanation: «Were to» підкреслює, що мовець вважає подію малоймовірною.

questions.title: He spoke ___ he had rehearsed every word in advance.
questions.explanation: «As though» уводить нереальне порівняння з формою минулого часу.

questions.title: ___ that the evidence is accepted, the case will proceed to trial.
questions.explanation: «Assuming that» уводить припущення, на якому будується висновок.

questions.title: Match each formal conditional expression with its plain equivalent.
questions.explanation: Формальні звороти умови мають прості розмовні відповідники.

questions.title: Match each hypothetical structure with the degree of remoteness it signals.
questions.explanation: Форма умови показує, наскільки реальною мовець вважає ситуацію.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the emotion or attitude it conveys.
questions.explanation: Конструкція умови передає ще й ставлення мовця: жаль, побажання, тривогу.

questions.title: What Happens to Ice — gap 1
questions.explanation: Загальна істина — нульовий тип: if + Present Simple, you без -s.

questions.title: What Happens to Ice — gap 2
questions.explanation: Нульовий тип: в обох частинах Present Simple, it turns.

questions.title: What Happens to Ice — gap 3
questions.explanation: Уявна ситуація (if we left) — другий тип: would happen.

questions.title: What Happens to Ice — gap 4
questions.explanation: Перший тип: після if — Present Simple, у головній частині will.

questions.title: What Happens to Ice — gap 5
questions.explanation: Перший тип: у підрядній з if — Present Simple, третя особа.

questions.title: What Would You Do with a Million? — gap 1
questions.explanation: Уявна ситуація (if we won) — другий тип: would do.

questions.title: What Would You Do with a Million? — gap 2
questions.explanation: Другий тип: після if — Past Simple, had.

questions.title: What Would You Do with a Million? — gap 3
questions.explanation: Другий тип у головній частині — wouldn't spend; would have spent належить до третього типу.

questions.title: What Would You Do with a Million? — gap 4
questions.explanation: Сталий вираз поради: If I were you.

questions.title: What Would You Do with a Million? — gap 5
questions.explanation: Другий тип: після if — Past Simple; let у минулому не змінюється.

questions.title: The Missed Bus — gap 1
questions.explanation: Третій тип про минуле, якого не змінити: if + Past Perfect.

questions.title: The Missed Bus — gap 2
questions.explanation: Третій тип у головній частині — would have + третій стан: wouldn't have been.

questions.title: The Missed Bus — gap 3
questions.explanation: Третій тип: після if — Past Perfect, had set.

questions.title: The Missed Bus — gap 4
questions.explanation: Перший тип (next time, I will take): після if — Present Simple.

questions.title: The Missed Bus — gap 5
questions.explanation: Другий тип (I would ride): після if — Past Simple, had.

questions.title: An Accidental Discovery — gap 1
questions.explanation: Третій тип (would never have grown): if + Past Perfect.

questions.title: An Accidental Discovery — gap 2
questions.explanation: Змішаний тип: минула умова (не був би спостережливим тоді) і теперішній наслідок (might still be waiting) — if + Past Perfect.

questions.title: An Accidental Discovery — gap 3
questions.explanation: Реальне попередження про майбутнє з unless — перший тип: will stop.

questions.title: An Accidental Discovery — gap 4
questions.explanation: Другий тип (would be far less common): після if — Past Simple, didn't stop.

questions.title: An Accidental Discovery — gap 5
questions.explanation: Інверсія Had Fleming not been — третій тип: would have been lost.
